en: Psalms 73
A Psalm by Asaph.

p.src: 1  Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

ja: い者たちに良くしてくださる。
en: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
u.src: 1  Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

en: 73:1 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים” (Elohim).

p.src: 2  But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.

ja: にも踏み外すところだった。
en: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.
u.src: 2  But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.

p.src: 3  For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

ja: たちをねたんだからだ。
en: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
u.src: 3  For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

p.src: 4  For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.

ja: しまず、 その体は健やかである。
en: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.
u.src: 4  For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.

p.src: 5  They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.

ja: らは人の苦労を知らず、 ほかの
々のように打たれることもない。
en: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.
u.src: 5  They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.

p.src: 6  Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.

en: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.
u.src: 6  Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.

p.src: 7  Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.

ja: い描くことは限りなく膨らんでいる。
en: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
u.src: 7  Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.

p.src: 8  They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.

ja: ぶって、人を虐げることを語る。
en: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.
u.src: 8  They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.

p.src: 9  They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.

ja: かって口を開き、 その
en: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
u.src: 9  They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.

p.src: 10  Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.

ja: は彼らのもとに戻り、 あふれる
en: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.
u.src: 10  Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.

p.src: 11  They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”

en: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”
u.src: 11  They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”

p.src: 12  Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.

en: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.
u.src: 12  Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.

p.src: 13  Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,

ja: ったのは、むなしいことであった。
en: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,
u.src: 13  Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,

p.src: 14  For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.

en: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.
u.src: 14  For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.

p.src: 15  If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.

en: If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
u.src: 15  If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.

p.src: 16  When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—

ja: 私がこれを理解しようとしたとき、 それは
にはあまりにも難しいことだった。
en: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—
u.src: 16  When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—

p.src: 17  until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.

en: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.
u.src: 17  until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.

p.src: 18  Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.

en: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
u.src: 18  Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.

p.src: 19  How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.

ja: らは突然滅ぼされることだろう。
のうちに完全に一掃される。
en: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
u.src: 19  How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.

p.src: 20  As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.

ja: らの幻をさげすまれる。
en: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.
u.src: 20  As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.

ja: 73:20 「主」と訳された言葉は「アドナイ」である。
en: 73:20 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.”

p.src: 21  For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.

ja: は悲しみ、 私の内は
されるように痛んでいた。
en: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.
u.src: 21  For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.

p.src: 22  I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.

ja: で、悟りがなく、 あなたの御
en: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
u.src: 22  I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.

p.src: 23  Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.

en: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
u.src: 23  Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.

p.src: 24  You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

ja: あなたはご自身の助言によって
en: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
u.src: 24  You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

p.src: 25  Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.

ja: において、あなたのほかに誰が
においても、あなたのほかに私が望む方はいない。
en: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
u.src: 25  Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.

p.src: 26  My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

en: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
u.src: 26  My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

p.src: 27  For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.

ja: たちを、あなたはすべて
en: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.
u.src: 27  For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.

p.src: 28  But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.

ja: づくことは良いことである。
とした。 私はあなたのすべての
en: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
u.src: 28  But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.

en: 73:28 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).
